Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief jobs-report article describes a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%. The available text does not specify a report date.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant presents itself as a cozy, alpine-inspired Swiss eatery with cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. It highlights rustic wooden interiors, city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The available content is straightforward: it identifies the site as yours and makes your contact email easy to find. I think adding a short introduction about yourself and what visitors can expect would make it more engaging and give them a reason to explore further. My feedback is based on the text I could access, rather than the visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. I like that you mention hiking—it gives your blog a personal focus. The text I could access is very brief, so I'd suggest adding some hiking stories, favorite routes, or practical trail tips to give readers more to explore. My feedback is based on the available text, rather than the visual design.
